headings.usage: Hero headers, product titles, major section headings for elegant Indonesian fashion vibe.

body.usage: Admin dashboard, product descriptions, UI elements, navigation. Provides a modern geometric contrast to the serif headings.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards, gap-8 to gap-12 between sections.
layouts.customer_home: Full bleed hero image with bg-black/50 overlay. Bento grid for categories (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps).
layouts.product_listing: Responsive grid: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Minimalist cards with subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1).
layouts.product_detail: Two-column layout (lg:grid-cols-2). Left: Framer Motion Stack gallery. Right: Product info, Add to Cart / WA CTA.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout. Dense data grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6). Recharts wrappers using rounded-2xl.
layouts.admin_products_crud: Card-based form sections. Table layout for list view using Shadcn Table.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#e4d3b5] text-[#09090b] font-medium px-8 py-3 transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-[#18181b] text-[#e4d3b5] border border-white/10 px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#27272a] transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-zinc-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#e4d3b5] focus:border-transparent text-white

click_spark.usage: Wrap all primary CTAs (Add to Cart, Buy Now, Checkout WA).

dock.styling: Fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-900/80 border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex gap-6

gooey_nav.usage: Desktop main navigation for customer site.
gooey_nav.styling: Sticky top-0 z-50 pt-4 px-8. Links have gooey fluid hover background using Framer Motion SVG filters.

stack.styling: Absolute positioned cards with random rotation (-5deg to 5deg). Click sends front card to back using layoutId or z-index animation.

motion.page_transitions: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion.hover_states: scale 1.02 on cards, bg color transitions duration-200
motion.stagger_reveals: transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.1 }} for product grids and list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text meets APCA guidelines against background. Buttons must have minimum 3:1 contrast.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like Dock items).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling Stack and GooeyNav effects if set.

testing.guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready dark-theme e-commerce store + admin panel using React, FastAPI, MongoDB.
Strictly avoid 'AI slop' defaults. Do NOT use Inter, generic gradients, or boring centered layouts.
Implement the 4 required Framer Motion custom components exactly as specified (ClickSpark, Dock, GooeyNav, Stack) in React.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Outfit for UI body text to create a high-end luxury fashion SaaS vibe.
DO NOT apply generic `transition-all` classes; use specific transition utility classes (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`) to avoid breaking Framer Motion animations.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are placed on all interactive elements.
WhatsApp integration must format the message properly using the template from admin settings (default WA: +6288211118394).
Admin dashboard Recharts must use the color palette provided here (#e4d3b5, #fafafa).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlapping navbars or docks; use the specified glassmorphism specs.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use specific properties for transitions (NOT transition: all).
All interactive elements need hover/focus states.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided media URLs.
Sonner is required for toast notifications.
Follow standard Indonesian fashion taxonomy (Baju, Celana, Aksesoris) for seed data.
